post.text: NZQA | Mana Tohu Mātauranga o Aotearoa @NZQAofficial Jan 19, 2022 NCEA results will be released tomorrow, and available from nzqa.govt.nz/login If you have trouble accessing your results, or have any questions, call us on 0800 697 296, use our webchat, or email helpdesk@nzqa.govt.nz Marked papers will be available online from 31 January.
